title: Restart the visual world
question: Fresh hand. The roll assigned Watchmaker’s Bench. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll again.

options.label: Watchmaker’s Bench
options.lineage: a movement under a loupe on a felt bench
options.thesis: One kit control is the movement; everything else is tools at the edge of the loupe.
options.viewport: Felt ground; one giant Knob in a brass loupe; accession-small labels; a right rail of control names as tool wells.
options.risk: Can read as jewelry, not a plugin family you would ship.

raised.raise: Grid: labels and the hit share one strict cell grid; nothing floats off the bench.
Cue-Phase: idle, hover, pressed, disabled are named cues with pattern, never hue alone.
Deploy: one pull opens a tessellation of sizes and states around the live hit.

options.label: Parts Drawer
options.thesis: Each control lives in its own felt compartment; you pull one drawer, you judge one part.
options.viewport: A tray of labeled wells; the selected well is empty of siblings and holds the live Knob or Pad at full size.
options.risk: The familiar hardware-catalog landing: parts in boxes, closest to a shop drawer.

options.label: Nixie Counter
options.thesis: The readout is plasma digits in glass; the kit control is the device under test beside the bank.
options.viewport: A tube bank for value; the live Slider or Knob sits as the DUT; labels engraved under the chassis.
options.case: Holds identification (lab instrument) and loses clarity (tubes compete with the hit).
options.risk: Orange plasma can feel like TE-adjacent function color unless it stays digits-only.

options.label: Elbow Panel
options.thesis: Control types are pastel pill banks; the live widget sits in the black glass inside the elbow.
options.viewport: A lilac elbow frames the canvas; peach/gold/periwinkle pills are Knob, Slider, Pad, Stepper; gold is the active view.
options.case: Holds clarity (pills as stories) and loses identification (pastel sci-fi, not a shippable plugin family).
options.risk: Costume wall panel if the elbows outrank the control.

options.label: Lineup Sheet
options.thesis: Hierarchy is size alone; the selected name inverts and the control appears at headline scale.
options.viewport: KNOB as the headliner spanning the width; Slider, Pad, Stepper as supporting type; the live widget sits in the inverted name.
options.case: Holds identification (music culture) and loses clarity (type billing is not an isolated hit).
options.risk: A poster that forgot it is a component library.

options.label: ASCII Live Scene
options.lineage: luminance as glyph density on a monospace grid
options.thesis: The control is sculpture made of characters.
options.viewport: A knob rendered as a rotating glyph mass; the index is more text in the same grid.
options.case: Loses both: ASCII demo, not a family of plugins.
options.kept: Grid: one strict cell grid owns the whole bench.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.lineage: theater cyc from night through dawn
options.thesis: States are lighting cues on an infinite horizon.
options.viewport: The control stands in front of a cyc that scrubs idle to pressed as dawn.
options.case: Loses both: atmosphere hides the isolated hit.
options.kept: Cue-Phase: named states with pattern, not color alone.

options.label: Miura Sheet
options.thesis: A packet unfolds into a tessellation of every state.
options.viewport: A compact packet labeled Knob; one pull deploys a grid of sizes and states.
options.case: Loses both: origami is not how you inspect a pad.
options.kept: Deploy: one gesture opens the full state field.

canonCard.label: Storybook, played straight
canonCard.thesis: Sidebar of stories, canvas, addon panel — the category explorer at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Left: Knob, Slider, Pad, Stepper, Nameplate, Surface. Center: the isolated control. Right: props.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other component library, on purpose.
